annotations.title: Team skills matrix and bus-factor analysis

description: Team skills matrix and bus-factor analysis — Offline skills matrix for a team. Give team= as Name:skill=level,skill=level;Name2:... (levels 0-3, or scale=5) and optional required=skill=level,... minimum levels. Returns bus factor and risk (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW) per skill, single points of failure, mentoring pairs (expert to nearest learner), per-person strengths and gaps, a team health score and a markdown matrix. Params: team, required, scale. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: business_skills_matrix
